tasteFindings.message: 3 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Transformamos ideas en soluciones digitales real" → 3 lines (6 words, 67px); "Más que código, construimos soluciones que funci" → 3 lines (7 words, 45px); "Tu sector tiene retos. Nosotros ayudamos a resol" → 3 lines (8 words, 45px)
tasteFindings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

tasteFindings.message: 6 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "ESTUDIO DE DESARROLLO DIGITAL" above "Transformamos ideas en soluciones digita"; "QUÉ HACEMOS" above "Tecnología diseñada para cada desafío"; "POR QUÉ NEXO" above "Más que código, construimos soluciones q"; "NUESTRO PROCESO" above "Una forma clara de hacer las cosas"; "SOLUCIONES PARA NEGOCIOS" above "Tu sector tiene retos. Nosotros ayudamos"
tasteFindings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

tasteFindings.message: Monospace type outside code: monospace — e.g. "build into reality", "<", "ideas", "/>"
tasteFindings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

tasteFindings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03", "04", "05", "06"
tasteFindings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

tasteFindings.message: 11 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "ESTUDIO DE DESARROLLO DIGITAL", "NEXO / DIGITAL WORKSPACE", "QUÉ HACEMOS", "POR QUÉ NEXO").
tasteFindings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

tasteFindings.message: 3 gradient fill(s): section.hero → radial-gradient(at 72% 30%, rgb(18, 46, 83) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 52%), linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(7, 17, 31)  | div.feature-visual → linear-gradient(130deg, rgb(16, 30, 54), rgb(9, 19, 38)) | section.container.cta-band → linear-gradient(115deg, rgb(9, 96, 202), rgb(7, 59, 142) 65%, rgb(7, 30, 79))
tasteFindings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

tasteFindings.message: 5 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.dashboard → rgba(3, 8, 17, 0.667) 0px 35px 100px 0px | div.visual-float.float-code → rgba(3, 8, 17, 0.533) 0px 20px 35px 0px | div.visual-float.float-mobile → rgba(3, 8, 17, 0.533) 0px 20px 35px 0px
tasteFindings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

tasteFindings.message: 5 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.site-header 1440px | div.dash-top 510px | div.graph-bars 427px | div.stats-strip 1440px
tasteFindings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

tasteFindings.message: 17 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
tasteFindings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

tasteFindings.message: 3 backdrop-blur surfaces.
tasteFindings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

tasteFindings.message: 1 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (6 cards).
tasteFindings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.

tasteFindings.message: 3 typefaces in use (DM Sans, Manrope, monospace).
tasteFindings.fix: Two at most.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

tasteFindings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
tasteFindings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

tasteFindings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
tasteFindings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

tasteFindings.message: 38 text blocks under 13px.
tasteFindings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

tasteFindings.message: The margins differ: 130px on the left, 160px on the right, at 1440px.
tasteFindings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

tasteFindings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 11 different lines (130px, 190px, 162px, 562px, 962px, 1076px, 369px); the three most used hold only 56% of it.
tasteFindings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

tasteFindings.message: Only 0 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
tasteFindings.fix: Build the motion layer (SKILL.md step 9, references/motion.md): the signature move, an entrance for the parts of every section, feedback on every control, and one moving picture. Transform and opacity only, with a reduced-motion fallback.
